summary: Pre-application consultation ran March-April 2026 with very low reported engagement: the developer reports 4 attendees at the first public exhibition (24 March 2026, Branchton Community Centre) and none at the first online event (26 March 2026). Developer-summarised feedback themes were noise, environmental impact, job creation, traffic and support for brownfield redevelopment; the developer claims respondents unanimously supported the site as appropriate infrastructure. No organised local opposition, community council position or press coverage of objections was found by 30 July 2026. APRS lists the project on its national data centre tracker.
